adelaide-42.evidence: Title 'Port Adelaide Museum - Port Adelaide Historical Society'; page says museum at 95 Fletcher Road Peterhead, Entry $5.00 (children with an adult free)

barossa-valley-5.evidence: No own site found. barossa.com/visit/things-to-do/barossa-museum/ is a regional wine/tourism body listing, not the operator; guessed domains did not resolve.
barossa-valley-5.price_note: Barossa Visitor Centre heritage factsheet (Aug 2026, barossa.com) lists adult $5, child $2: matches $5.

mannum-1.evidence: No own site found. Run by Mid Murray Council; its page mid-murray.sa.gov.au/Tourism/learn-about-river-history-at-mannum,-swan-reach,-morgan-and-cadell-museums covers four museums and returned a bot wall. themurrayriver.com listing is a tourism directory.
mannum-1.price_note: southaustralia.com listing shows adult $7.50 (matches); themurrayriver.com shows $5; centre noted as being re-interpreted.

mount-gambier-4.evidence: Old operator site engelbrechtcave.com now says 'We have closed our business, tours may be available through new management', so not linkable. Visit Mount Gambier page (visitmountgambier.com.au/travel/engelbrecht-cave-2/, title 'Engelbrecht Cave - Mount Gambier') says paid guided 30-min tour, bookings essential via a 'Visit website' link that could not be read (Cloudflare).
mount-gambier-4.price_note: southaustralia.com listing shows adult $14.50 (older $12.50, which is what the spot has); a newer listing shows from $10.50 for a 30-min tour. Spot price looks stale.

yorke-peninsula-9.evidence: No working official site. portvictoria.org.au/Maritimemuseum.html (linked from visityorkepeninsula.com.au) failed to load; no National Trust page found.

yorke-peninsula-17.evidence: stansburymuseum.com redirects to a generic 'Stansbury, Yorke Peninsula | Museums, Heritage and Coast' visitor guide, not clearly the museum's own site; not used.

yorke-peninsula-18.evidence: Title 'Edithburgh Museum - Edithburgh'; heading 'Edithburgh Museum'; linked from visityorkepeninsula.com.au museums page. Community Edithburgh town site hosting the museum's own page.
yorke-peninsula-18.price_note: Page shows Admission $5.00 (children 5-14 $1.00); spot has $3. Update to $5.

yorke-peninsula-19.evidence: Privately owned; no own site. veteranssa.sa.gov.au event listing is not an official museum site (and blocked).

port-broughton-heritage-centre.evidence: No own site found; only directory listings (explore.history.sa.gov.au, southaustralia.com).
port-broughton-heritage-centre.price_note: southaustralia.com listing: adult $7, concession $5, family $15: matches $7.

neptune-islands.evidence: Sold by several licensed operators (parks.sa.gov.au/parks/neptune-islands-group, title 'Neptune Islands...', says three tour operators are licensed), so none by the rule. Agency park page exists if you prefer it.

kimba-museum.evidence: Kimba Gawler Ranges Historical Society has no own site found. Council page kimba.sa.gov.au/services/points-of-interest/kimba-gawler-rangers-historical-museum returned a bot wall (council listing, not the society).

ikara-flinders-ranges-7.evidence: Title 'Ikara-Flinders... - National Parks and Wildlife Service South Australia'; page has a 'Yura Mulka (Sacred Canyon)' section: restricted access, Adnyamathanha guided tours booked via Wilpena Pound Resort or Wadna. Park-level page (no Sacred Canyon subpage; guessed deep link 404s).
ikara-flinders-ranges-7.price_note: Wilpena Pound Resort's booking page lists from $130 (other listings $120/$105; trade listing $95): $120-130 plausible.

quorn-2.evidence: Managing page is the Flinders Ranges Council (frc.sa.gov.au/tourism/where-to-stay/bushcamping/warren-gorge) but it returned a bot wall; title not confirmed.
quorn-2.price_note: Search snippet of the council listing: $5 per vehicle day entry, $18 per vehicle per night camping: matches $5.

coober-pedy-3.evidence: Title 'Underground | Tom's Opal Mine | Coober Pedy' (tomsworkingopalmine.com redirects there); tours page 'Tours | Toms Opal Mine'.
coober-pedy-3.price_note: Site shows Adult $40, concession $34, child $15, family $100; spot has $15 (that was the old self-guided adult price). Update to $40.

coober-pedy-6.evidence: No official site found (candidate domains do not resolve); only Lonely Planet/Wikivoyage listings.
